AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To analyze the clinical efficacy of hematoporphyrin monomethyl ether photodynamic therapy (HMME-PDT) in treating port-wine stains (PWS), and its clinical operation skills and operation essentials.

AbstractText.Label: METHOD
AbstractText.content: A total of 16 cases of PWS with negative HMME skin test results were included in this study. Their treated areas were exposed and injected with 5mg/kg HMME, and then irradiated under 532nm LED green light, with the irradiation power density between 90-100mW/cm(2). Each light spot was irradiated for 20-30min. After one treatment, the clinical efficacy and post-treatment reactions at each treated area were observed.

AbstractText.Label: RESULT
AbstractText.content: Under standard operation, two of the 16 cases were cured (12.5%) after one HMME-PDT treatment, nine cases indicates a good efficacy (48.89%), four cases showed alleviation (25.0%), while two cases displayed no efficacy (12.5%), indicating an one-time response rate of 87.5%. Pain was reported during treatment, and significant post-treatment edema was observed at the treated areas; And no allergy or other adverse reaction were reported.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: In adherence to operation standards and operation essentials during treatment, HMME-PDT shows a satisfactory clinical efficacy in treating PWS.
